name: Functions guide framing
does: Headings and a pointer back to root CLAUDE.md
costNote: attached lazily as nested_memory on first functions/ file touch

name: Standard test order
does: auth then authorization then validation then business logic then success

name: Mock firebase-functions when logging
does: Always mock firebase-functions if the code uses logger

name: Import test constants from mock-data
does: Never hardcode IDs, phones, or values; generated ids keep the 20-char shape

name: Shared fixture builders live in mock-data
does: Factories for domain or external-API shapes go in mock-data, not local build* helpers

name: Use DB test utilities
does: addOrderToDB and friends instead of partial objects with as casts

name: setFakeTimer for consistent dates
does: Capture now from setFakeTimer, never Date.now, never at module scope, pass clock-derived defaults explicitly
preventsClaim: timing variation, later tests inheriting the wrong clock, snapshot drift with emulator latency

name: Hoist shared setup into beforeEach
does: Setup every it() repeats belongs in one beforeEach unless the helper is the file's subject

name: Use DB snapshot and diff helpers
does: getDBSnapshot, getDBChanges, expectNoDBChanges for database testing

name: Never read Firestore in a test
does: No .get(), no testAllQuery; assert via DB diffs over the sibling tests' ref set

name: Snapshot the whole WhatsApp send
does: Snapshot the full send* mock call; the body text is the assertion
preventsClaim: asserting only that a send happened

name: Register a serializer, never hand-build
does: When one value blocks a whole-call snapshot, add a serializer in @/test/expect
preventsClaim: falling back to a hand-built object or a drilled mock.calls index

name: Subcollection snapshots need parent ref
does: Include the parent collection ref in getDBSnapshot for subcollections
preventsClaim: snapshot utilities throw Document not found without parent docs

name: Scheduled function test pattern
does: Read __endpoint.scheduleTrigger and fire with fn.run({scheduleTime})

name: New src directory needs a CI shard
does: Add the directory to the ci:test:* globs or its tests never run in CI
preventsClaim: tests in an unlisted top-level directory silently never run

name: All queries must use db-refs
does: Never reach for a raw collection off db.getFirestore()

name: Nested-field write pattern
does: Use PartialWithFieldValue merging sets with conditional spreads for dotted keys
preventsClaim: UpdateData cannot descend into an interface, so the key fails with TS7053

name: One write per document per path
does: Accumulate fields and write once at the bail point

name: Function structure order
does: Authentication, Validation, Authorization, Business Logic, Response

name: Cloud task four-step recipe
does: Action+data type, enqueue utility, handler, router case; new dispatcher only for different config

name: Task ids dedupe enqueues
does: Catch and silently ignore HandledFirebaseError.TaskAlreadyExists

name: Plain ref.get in task handlers
does: Never checkDocumentExists in a task handler; logger.error instead
preventsClaim: Cloud Tasks treats a throw as retry

name: Callable file layout
does: Six-file layout per callable group plus two index exports

name: No caller-level truncate guards
does: sendWhatsApp* enforces character limits internally; callers add logic only for graceful degradation

name: Never re-declare WhatsApp limits
does: Take limits from @whatsapp-cloudapi/client constants; a self-imposed cap gets a comment

name: Helper first, handler is orchestration
does: Look for an existing helper, extract a shared one; response assembly goes to internal/ with tests
preventsClaim: a block mirrors an existing flow's body

name: Error logs name a human
does: Never write skipping or left for the next run; append needs investigation; levels bind everywhere
preventsClaim: an alert-worthy state is worded as self-clearing

name: Await async calls
does: Never call an async function without await
preventsClaim: Firebase Functions terminate before fire-and-forget work completes

name: Validation, transactions, result enums
does: validateSchemaAndTrim, transactions for multi-doc writes, result enums for expected errors

name: Webhook error category table
does: Four categories map to log level and HTTP behavior for Stripe and WhatsApp
preventsClaim: logger.error triggers alerts, so a miscategorized error creates noise or hides a real one

name: Every logger.error carries the event id
does: Routers set context.eventId; WhatsApp always returns 200 to Meta
preventsClaim: an event cannot be replayed from the Stripe dashboard after a fix

name: Stripe webhook router cast pattern
does: Keep the broad Stripe.Event, cast at the switch boundary, return Unrecoverable in default
preventsClaim: narrowing above the switch defeats assertNever exhaustiveness

name: Hosting guide framing
does: Heading and pointer to the required UI workflow and root CLAUDE.md
costNote: lazy nested_memory on first hosting/ file touch

name: Store versus composable
does: Pinia store for cross-page or persisted state; composable for everything else

name: Store pattern rules
does: undefined means not loaded, getDocAndCache, useAppStateManager lifecycle, loading=false per path
preventsClaim: resetting state in finally clears it before the error page renders

name: Page composable split
does: Pages hold markup and definePageMeta; logic lives in a use<Name>Page composable with a colocated test
preventsClaim: no atom, molecule or page carries a colocated test, so page logic would go untested

name: UX prefix for UI mirror types
does: Name editable mirrors of domain types UXXxx

name: scdate comparison helpers
does: Use isSameTime/areWeekdaysEqual/isSameDate, never ===
preventsClaim: scdate values are objects, so reference equality fails for equal values

name: Single root for attr inheritance
does: Wrap conditional roots in one div when the component must inherit class
preventsClaim: a fragment root cannot inherit attrs

name: formatDemoName once per context
does: Apply to one of business or location name, not both

name: Every back button declares backTo
does: definePageMeta({backTo}) used when there is no in-app history, navigated with replace
preventsClaim: back falls to the home page on refresh, fresh tab, external link or PWA resume

name: firebase-kit binding layout
does: One export per bound collaborator; callerDependencies assembles them; one typed caller per group

name: Keepalive caller for fire-and-forget reports
does: Attribution touches go through getFastKeepalive, which never throws and logs via onError
preventsClaim: a public page waits on a report it must not wait on

name: Let exceptions reach Vue handlers
does: No try/catch; handle expected business results with if

name: Only UnoCSS theme tokens
does: Use only spacing, colors and sizes defined in the UnoCSS config

name: Spanish voice for UI text
does: Conversational Puerto Rican Spanish; check the Word Choices table before changing text
costNote: lazy; spanish-voice.md is a 98-line on-demand read

name: Packages guide framing
does: Heading and pointer to root CLAUDE.md
costNote: lazy nested_memory on first packages/ file touch

name: Entity type conventions
does: Entities extend Testable and Versioned

name: Use ID aliases, no casts
does: Use BusinessID/OrderID aliases; restates that they are documentation-only

name: GlobalTimestamp and MakeDB
does: GlobalTimestamp for created/updated; DBEntity types via MakeDB<Entity>

name: Constants package conventions
does: kebab-case enum values, enum values in type positions, PascalCase constant objects, document external matches

name: Validation package conventions
does: betterbe object notation, reusable field validators, validateSchemaAndTrim in functions
